meta.description: Reserved and on-demand GPU cloud instances for ML training and inference. Use when you need dedicated GPU instances with simple SSH access, persistent filesystems, or high-performance multi-node clusters for large-scale training.

howto.when: 当你需要为机器学习训练或推理获取 GPU 云实例，例如需要 SSH 访问、持久化存储或多节点集群时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you manage Lambda Labs GPU cloud instances: list available GPU types, launch/terminate instances, manage SSH keys and persistent filesystems, and run training or inference tasks.
